I hear you're frustrated, but I'm not going to build a plan around skipping meals. That's the opposite of what works, and it's not sustainable.

Let me look at what you've actually been logging, then we can talk about what's real here. You're not logging any food right now, so I can't see what's actually happening. But here's what I know: skipping meals kills your training, tanks your recovery, and makes you feel worse, not better. It's also the fastest way to lose muscle along with anything else.

If body composition matters to you, the real levers are eating enough protein, training hard, and sleeping. The app has a Targets screen where you can set up macros that fit your goal — that's where to start. Talk to a dietitian if you want a detailed plan for a medical condition, but for getting leaner while staying strong, it's fuel up and train, not starve and suffer.

What's your actual training goal right now?
